name: Gnoll Marauder
tactics: Gnoll marauders gang up on a single target to gain the benefit of their pack attack power. It uses its quick bite against bloodied foes whenever possible.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description:
Leather armor is sturdier than cloth armor. It protects vital areas with multiple layers of boiled-leather plates, while covering the limbs with supple leather that provides a small amount of protection.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Leather armor grants +3 AC at levels 16-25, and +4 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Light Shield
items.description: While you’re using a light shield, you can use your shield hand to hold another item, to climb, and the like, but you can’t make attacks with that hand or with anything in it.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Pack Attack
traits.details: The gnoll marauder deals an extra 5 damage on melee attacks against an enemy that has two or more of the marauder’s allies adjacent to it.

powers.name: Quick Bite
powers.trigger: when gnoll marauder hits a bloodied enemy with a melee attack
powers.range: The gnoll marauder makes a bite attack against the same target

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.range: The gnoll marauder makes a bite attack against the same target
